_comment: RecallAI launcher steps, run top to bottom. 'enabled' is the default; your own on/off choices are saved in settings.local.json. {python}/{npm}/{spacetime} are filled in automatically. cwd is relative to the repository root.

steps.name: Check Grok key
steps.description: Verifies XAI_API_KEY (.env) works before anything starts. Optional.

steps.name: SpacetimeDB
steps.description: Local SpacetimeDB database on port 3000 (only needed for the live dashboard).

steps.name: Publish SpacetimeDB module
steps.description: Uploads spacetimedb/ as database 'recallai' (safe to repeat; keeps data).

steps.name: RecallAI server
steps.description: FastAPI on port 8000: search page, Grok agent, alerts, camera feed, SpacetimeDB sync.

steps.name: Camera
steps.description: Webcam + YOLO + DINOv2 recognition. Opens its own video window (press Q there to quit).

steps.name: Camera dashboard
steps.description: Live camera, last locations, people and the Add button (port 5173). Opens in your browser.

steps.name: Live dashboard (SpacetimeDB)
steps.description: Real-time dashboard on port 5174. Needs SpacetimeDB + Publish above.
